description: Answers: should I repeat this claim or headline as a fact, and how should I word it? Same free word-rule passport as get_news_passport (no AI, no web search), under a name for the job: status (reported event, statement, plan or promise, threat or warning, demand, forecast, question), checkability (who / when / how many / where, vague words), state media, loaded tone, and, when the text is on the Orb Studio radars, how many outlets carry it, its age and whether retellings amplified it; then confidence (high / medium / low) and plain 'say' lines. Measures how the claim is built and how widely it is carried, not whether it is true. To count outlets in the news search use check_headline.
